- All diff lines should start with one of the special characters above and a space following them. Other lines will be completely ignored
Here is an example of a diff:

Text before:
hello
world
a
b cd
line2
line3


Example of model output (diff in the format you must follow):
@@ a @@
+ inserted-after-a
@@ b cd @@
- line2
= line3
+ after3

Text after:
hello
world
a
inserted-after-a
b cd
line3
after3
